emergence.summary: A single-gene DMD loss-of-function (X-linked): out-of-frame deletions/duplications or nonsense alleles abolish dystrophin, the protein that anchors the muscle cytoskeleton to the sarcolemmal dystroglycan complex, so the membrane becomes fragile and muscle degenerates progressively -> the supply of FUNCTIONAL dystrophin (sarcolemmal structural integrity) is driven DOWN. The frame-disrupting lesion is a CODING change, not a promoter change (like sickle cell's coding missense): the promoter gamma read here is of the DMD LOCUS switch structure, and the disease direction is forced by the structural loss-of-function biology. In-frame deletions (Becker MD) leave a partial dystrophin -> milder, which is the dosage axis the corrective levers exploit. Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: sarcolemmal structural integrity (supply of functional dystrophin to muscle)

per_gene.perturbation_reason: structural element deficient -> tissue integrity reduced

grades.perturbation_direction: [F] forced by (role x mechanism); cited biology
grades.perturbation_magnitude: [O] OPEN -- how far the switch moves is runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable

per_gene.note: Dystrophin links F-actin to the dystrophin-glycoprotein complex at the sarcolemma; out-of-frame/null alleles abolish functional dystrophin -> membrane fragility and contraction-induced damage. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; it does NOT encode the frame-disrupting coding lesion (firewall). In-frame (Becker) deletions yield a shorter but partly functional dystrophin -> milder phenotype, consistent with a functional-dystrophin dosage axis.

primary_switch.reason: structural element deficient -> tissue integrity reduced

emergence.firewall: gamma reads promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only; perturbation DIRECTION is forced+cited; MAGNITUDE is [O] (runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable).

levers.push_direction: deliver a functional micro-dystrophin transgene -> restore a partial dystrophin at the sarcolemma
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] restored functional-dystrophin fraction / membrane-stabilisation magnitude not derived from sequence
levers.src: Mendell 2023 JAMA Neurol; delandistrogene moxeparvovec (Elevidys) FDA 2023

levers.push_direction: exon-skipping antisense restores the reading frame around the deletion -> a Becker-like internally-truncated but functional dystrophin
levers.agent_class: exon-skipping antisense oligonucleotide (eteplirsen / golodirsen / viltolarsen / casimersen; exon-specific)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] frame-restored dystrophin level / clinical magnitude not derived from sequence; benefit is exon-specific

levers.push_direction: promote ribosomal read-through of a premature stop codon -> full-length dystrophin (nonsense-allele subset only)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] read-through efficiency / dystrophin recovery not derived from sequence; nonsense-mutation subset only
levers.src: Bushby 2014 Muscle Nerve; ataluren EMA conditional 2014

levers.push_direction: up-regulate the dystrophin paralogue utrophin to compensate for absent dystrophin (mutation-independent)
levers.mechanism_grade: [O] utrophin-compensation magnitude not derived; the lead modulator did not meet its primary endpoint -- direction-only

lead_corrective_lever.push_direction: deliver a functional micro-dystrophin transgene -> restore a partial dystrophin at the sarcolemma
lead_corrective_lever.mechanism_grade: [O] restored functional-dystrophin fraction / membrane-stabilisation magnitude not derived from sequence
lead_corrective_lever.src: Mendell 2023 JAMA Neurol; delandistrogene moxeparvovec (Elevidys) FDA 2023

modelling.grade: [F] ordering forced ; delta/treat_frac documented choices ; realised magnitude [O]

treatment_A_switch.firewall: levers are DIRECTION + cited agent CLASS; not dose/potency/efficacy/safety, not a recommendation to treat any individual.

falsifiers.claim: DMD LOF lowers the sarcolemmal structural-integrity axis (functional dystrophin supply DOWN)
falsifiers.falsifier: a DMD out-of-frame/null allele that PRESERVED or INCREASED sarcolemmal integrity / functional dystrophin would refute the structural-loss direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: sarcolemmal dystrophin immunostaining and membrane-integrity (serum CK / Evans-blue dye uptake) by genotype in a Dmd-null model

falsifiers.claim: restoring partial dystrophin (replace / exon-skip / read-through) is the CORRECTIVE direction
falsifiers.falsifier: if supplying micro-dystrophin or frame-restored dystrophin WORSENED or failed to improve sarcolemmal integrity, the restore-dystrophin lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: membrane-integrity / muscle-function response to micro-dystrophin transfer or exon-skipping in a Dmd-null model

gate_falsifiers.gate: falsifier register (>=1 measurable falsifier per disease)
